propositions: Add a `rebar metrics` read subcommand that parses --since/--until and --output json|text and renders every MetricSpec in the registry over the whole range.
Wire metrics via an explicit `if sub == "metrics":` arm in _dispatch() on the store-initialized reads path, and add "metrics" to the individual frozenset in the help-overview coverage guard.
metrics.py must import the rebar.metrics package (not just registry) to trigger reader registration side-effects that hydrate REGISTRY.
The render loop builds a context carrying repo_root, since, until, calls registry.evaluate(spec, ctx), and composes each entry from spec.lens plus the MetricValue/Unavailable result.
Each evaluate call is wrapped in try/except so a failing metric renders as unavailable and every registered id always appears in output.
A source-level portability guard asserts metrics.py contains no rebar.metrics.adapters import, and golden help snapshots plus generated cli-reference.md must be regenerated.
